title: plugin-dashboard: DatasetWidget.test.tsx escapes to the real network on the dimension-metadata probe (same root cause as #5225)
body:
Found while fixing #5225 (plugin-report). Filed unassigned and **not** fixed there — that card's write surface is `packages/plugin-report`, and this is the same defect in a different package.

Measured on `origin/main` @ `41f498bcb`.

## The escape

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -c ECONNREFUSED
-> 10        # 5 real connection attempts; grep matches 2 lines per attempt
   Tests  52 passed (52)
```

Package-wide, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard` reports 10 ECONNREFUSED lines over 63 files / 575 tests, and a per-file bisect puts all of them in `DatasetWidget.test.tsx`:

```
DatasetWidget.test.tsx                       -> ECONNREFUSED x10
DatasetWidget.localSelectI18n.test.tsx       -> ECONNREFUSED x0
DashboardFilterBar.optionsFromRawValue.test.tsx -> ECONNREFUSED x0
```

The requests, captured with a `net.Socket.prototype.connect` probe:

```
GET http://localhost:3000/api/v1/meta/object/showcase_task   x3
GET http://localhost:3000/api/v1/meta/object/showcase_deal   x2
GET http://localhost:3000/api/v1/meta/object/invoices        x1
```

## Root cause — identical to #5225

```
DatasetWidget.tsx
  -> useDatasetDimensionMeta            packages/react/src/hooks/useDatasetDimensionLabels.ts
     -> `const doFetch = apiFetch ?? fetch`      <- the escape
        -> loadDimensionFieldMeta        packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts:1178
           GET /api/v1/meta/object/<object>
```

With no `SchemaRendererProvider` in the tree the hook has no host `apiFetch` and degrades to the global `fetch` — deliberate, documented, and pinned (objectui#4121). Under happy-dom the global `fetch` is a real HTTP client, and vitest's happy-dom environment defaults the document URL to `http://localhost:3000` (`vitest/dist/chunks/index.DC7d2Pf8.js`: `url: happyDOM.url || "http://localhost:3000"`), so the relative `/api/v1/...` resolves to a live request. The read is best-effort (`catch {}` leaves rows as the server sent them), which is why the suite is green while the request always fails.

Only the cases whose mocked query result carries `object` reach it — that field is what the hook keys on. The widget's own `dataSource` double serves the ROWS; the metadata is a second channel that never goes through it, which is why the existing mock does not intercept.

## Why it is not just noise

A dev server on port 3000 is routine in this repo's shared containers. If one is up those 5 attempts *connect* — to whatever another agent is running — and the widget's rendered labels change with no line of the test changing.

Also worth checking: a green test that quietly took the error path is not testing what it says. In #5225's plugin-report file all 42 pre-existing tests stayed green once the probe was answered from a double with no option-bearing fields (byte-identical to the failed read), but that has to be re-measured here rather than assumed.

## Relationship to the closed family

#4106's title names plugin-charts **and** plugin-dashboard, but its fix (`ce4b9e8af`) landed in five `packages/plugin-charts/**` files only — no plugin-dashboard file was touched. The call site it fixed (ObjectChart's own inline option-color effect) was later extracted into the shared `useDatasetDimensionMeta` hook by #4389, which is the site above. So this is the #4106 root cause at a consumer that sweep did not cover, not a new one.

#5225 (plugin-report) is the same, and its PR is the reference for the fix shape: answer the probe from a **recording** double that records every URL and fails on any non-metadata route, keep the answer option-free so no pre-existing assertion changes meaning, and pin the previously-unasserted request shape. ⛔ Not a blanket network stub and not an error-swallowing guard.

## Recheck

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -c ECONNREFUSED
```

Run vitest from the repo root (objectui#3378).
